notes.title: Update - 2022-09-26
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just released an update for La Pucelle: Ragnarok which corrects the following issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed black screen issue on loading saves created after recruiting characters.
[*] Fixed graphical issues with a certain stage.
[*] Fixed graphical issue with Udon shop.
[*] Fixed crash on start when using certain keyboard hardware with controller-like functions.
[/list]
